💰 £72 MILLION in 48 hours — and suddenly Westminster cares about big money in politics.

Ben Delo gave Reform UK £36m. Within 24 hours Christopher Harborne matched it. Reported as the largest donations in British political history — worth roughly three-quarters of what ALL parties spent at the 2024 general election combined.

⏱️ Now look at the timing. A donations cap was a nice idea in the spring. It went quiet over the summer. It became an emergency the moment the money went to the wrong party.

⚖️ My position is simple: cap donations properly if you're going to cap them — individuals, companies AND union political funds, all inside the same fence. What we won't accept is a rule written to hobble one party while the incumbents' own plumbing stays untouched.
